resources.string: Enhances WeChat notifications with modern libxposed API 102.
Restart the affected target process after changing a setting. WeChat enhancement is enabled by default.
Better notification for WeChat: Messaging Style, Direct Reply and Clear to Mark Read.
Keep your last notification reply when new messages arrive. Applies to subsequent notification updates.
Keep Unicode emoji instead of WeChat’s emoji labels or [表情] placeholder. Applies to new notifications on supported WeChat versions. Does not display sticker images.

Display **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~ and backtick code in WeChat notification messages. Code uses monospace text and a gray background where supported by the system. Original message and reply text are retained. Restart the WeChat process after changing this setting.
Show the received picture instead of [图片] in the notification. Requires a WeChat process restart after changing; with this off, notifications keep the original [图片] text.

Works only when “Image preview in notifications” is also enabled, the WeChat version is supported, and the local image does not meet the preview requirement. It asks WeChat to download its normal compressed image and waits up to 1.5 seconds from the notification image request, publishing sooner if ready. On timeout, it uses the best available image, or keeps the original notification if none is ready. Download completion within this limit is not guaranteed. It never requests the original image; a submitted WeChat download may continue in the background. Restart the WeChat process after changing this setting.
